title: Senge: shifting the burden
summary: A problem produces symptoms; a quick fix relieves the pressure but not the cause, so the motivation to pursue the real solution fades and the capacity to implement it atrophies. Every content filter, alignment patch and guardrail added after deployment follows this pattern.

nodes.label: Problem Symptom
nodes.description: Harm or failure visible to the organisation

nodes.label: Solution Capacity
nodes.description: Ability and motivation to implement the real fix

nodes.label: Fundamental Solution
nodes.description: Changing the structure that produces the harm

edges.description: Symptoms also create pressure for the real solution
The real solution would remove the cause
Relief lets the capacity for the real fix atrophy
Capacity is what carries out the fundamental solution

identifiability_note: A standard systems archetype; each link is directly observable in organisations.
